data.one_liner: Syntax highlighter in pure Dart for 55 languages, themes, incremental updates, and HTML output.
data.what_it_does: Provides syntax highlighting for 55 languages in pure Dart with no native code, WebView, or JavaScript dependencies. Includes incremental updates, pre-built themes, VS Code theme import, and HTML output for text rendering.
use_when: You need to highlight code snippets or render syntax-highlighted code in pure Dart across any platform.
You want incremental updates for a code editor experience.
You want to import VS Code themes into a Dart application.
avoid_when: You are looking for pre-built Flutter code editor widgets like CodeView or CodeField (use val_highlight_flutter instead).
strengths: Pure Dart with no native or JS dependencies, running on every platform.
Incremental updating designed for editors, scanning only affected lines.
Supports 55 languages and includes VS Code theme import.
weaknesses: Does not include Flutter-specific widgets out of the box (requires val_highlight_flutter for that).
Writing custom grammars from scratch can be complex.
